{{Top|leg}}
A '''sting ball''' was a type of projectile used in the [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], particularly during centering exercise. During the exercise, trainees would stand and [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] while a group shouted insults at them and pelted them with various missiles, ranging from kitchen leftovers to sting balls.<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
